$EDSA

I gave this to you a month ago at $1.20. 💰

In just about a month, this is now up 680%. 💸

Check screenshots below to see the guidance I provided for this trade every step of the way to make sure that your trade is MAXIMISED to the fullest potential. 

You don't see me talk about this as often today after the initial move is done because I am always focused on finding new actionable setups for all of you here.

But it doesn't mean I'm not riding shares! 

My philosophy for trading small caps is simple;

> Find a good actionable position, take entries.

> Trim profits on the way up and raise your stops accordingly.

> Most importantly, if trend does not break down, if our position isn't threatened, I'll ride it out as high as I can get.

The thing about small caps is that they are very good at making multi-bagger moves if trend holds. Think $AXTI and $IREN when they were both in the $1.00 area price point.

Those two companies may not necessarily be small caps but the concept stays the same on the initial stages of the trade until fundamentals and thematic changes takes over the rally. 

Most people ask for targets but the truth is none of us can really know where a stock will go even on the next minute.

Let the stock market do the work in pushing the price up. All you need to do is to manage your risk.

If trend holds, hold rest for more.

If trend fails, cut remaining position to maintain a green trade. 

Keeping things simple goes a long way. Don't over-complicate things when they don't need to be.
